notes.title: Mommy’s Slipper Has Launched — Wishlist, Feedback & Support Welcome!
notes.content: [p]🎮 Mommy’s Slipper is Now Live on Steam![/p][p]Hello everyone! I'm the solo developer of Mommy’s Slipper, and I’m thrilled to finally share it with you.[/p][p]This is my very first indie game — short, weird, and story-driven — made with passion and love.[/p][p]I’m incredibly thankful for every wishlist, feedback, and kind word.[/p][p]If you play the game, please let me know what you think — and don’t hesitate to share bugs or suggestions. Your feedback helps me make it better.[/p][p]💙 Add to your wishlist if you haven’t yet!  [/p][p]And yes… the slipper is real 😄[/p][p]Thank you for supporting an indie dev![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes – v1.1.0
notes.content:
Added function descriptions for each key in the Settings menu.

Introduced a new Tutorial section to help players learn the basics.

Implemented crouch functionality for improved stealth and control.

Adjusted in-game text sizes to improve readability.

Story transitions can now be skipped or continued manually with a key press.

Fixed bugs related to Brightness and Mouse Sensitivity settings.

A confirmation prompt ("Are you sure?") has been added before returning to the Main Menu.
